verdict.rationale: Brex runs travel booking and expense policy on one platform (docs-39). Booking objects exist with policy data (docs-6), uploaded receipts are auto-matched to existing expenses (docs-7, docs-27), and AI assistants fetch receipts and write memos (docs-23). A community user also confirms using Brex Travel (comm-1). Nothing in the pack shows these pieces being grouped automatically into a single trip- or itinerary-linked report. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic trip/itinerary grouping of bookings, card transactions and receipts into one report, documentation of an itinerary-linked expense report object or view, and hands-on corroboration.
